configuration.trigger: Dry instability, or near-saturated lower cell with a warmer saturated parcel above; no wind cap
configuration.target: Adjacent dry/neutral saturated parcel lapse, common vapor ratio and exact pair gas enthalpy; actual rain enthalpy
configuration.relaxation: Convex gas enthalpy/water and exported-rain budgets, then explicit phase of the homogenized mixture; first-order operator split

transport_water.scope: Fixed-mass multilevel conservative donor scalar; explicit reaction/supply, no phase or momentum/thermodynamic feedback

transport_enthalpy.scope: Fixed-mass multilevel conservative donor scalar; explicit reaction/supply, no phase or momentum/thermodynamic feedback

dynamics_before_adjustment.scope: Repeated dry/dilute pressure-coordinate enthalpy/vapor/phase/wind feedback; compression once. Zero depth-mean flow, fixed pressure bounds; no water loading/volume/potential/fall heat, ice, radiation or terrain.

convective_adjustment.scope: Instantaneous adjacent mixing: dry instability or saturated conditional instability, common vapor ratio and neutral parcel lapse, conservative liquid phase. No entrainment, convective momentum or explicit turbulence energy.

last_certificate.scope: First-order split repeated pressure-coordinate dynamics and conservative local convective adjustment; final pressure responds next step, no Earth adoption

experiment.scope: Manufactured reduced pressure-coordinate closure sensitivity, not calibration. Instantaneous neutral target need not remove all parcel energy; finite relaxation may retain active layers. No entrainment, convective momentum/TKE, ice, terrain, radiation, nonlinear momentum or Earth validation.

independent_publication_checks.scope: Actual final gas enthalpy+face kinetic+rain enthalpy and water, converged neutral targets, exact relaxation fraction, phase saturation and stable control. Closure sensitivity is not Earth validation.
